name: Elteza (AO Elteza, United Electrotechnical Plants)
via: Subsidiary of OAO Russian Railways per Elteza's own site (Aug 2026); RZD's stake in the chartered capital is 50% + 1 share per RZD's structure page (archived 2021)
note: Bombardier bought 50% minus 1 share in 2011; Bombardier Transportation was absorbed by Alstom in 2021. Who holds that stake in 2026 is unverified. Elteza also says it is part of the Natsproektstroy group (a Rostec-related holding).
